description: Welcome to this spacious flat, ideal for a stay with friends or family, sleeping up to 8 people. Ideally located in the heart of Paris close to the Grands Boulevards, you can easily get around to explore the capital and relax in this comfortable, fully-equipped accommodation after a day of sightseeing or work.The spaceAccommodation for up to 8 people, comprising :- two private bedrooms, each with a queen size bed- a spacious living room with two sofa-beds- a fully-equipped open-plan kitchen- 2 bathrooms with WCYou can also enjoy TV and WiFi in the accommodation.Guest accessYou will have the whole apartment to yourself!Other things to noteThanks to its central location, just a stone's throw from the Grands Boulevards, you'll be close to many of the capital's points of interest, which you can explore from the flat on foot or by public transport.- The Opéra Garnier is around twenty minutes away on foot or 10 minutes by metro- The Ile de la Cité, home to Notre-Dame-de-Paris, is 10 minutes away by metro- The Louvre Museum and the Tuileries Gardens, around twenty minutes away by metro- Montmartre and the Sacré-Coeur Basilica, around twenty minutes away by metro- 30 minutes by metro to the Eiffel TowerRegistration details7511012356324
